doc_title: Brackenholt Senior Lending Fund, LP Confidential Private Placement Memorandum with Executed Side Letter
notes: Semi-liquid evergreen private credit PPM with an executed side letter appended that gives one endowment a 0.95% management fee, a waiver of the 2.0% early repurchase deduction, and a key-person notification right carrying a 30-day tender window; every fund-level answer must come from the PPM body. The two-part incentive fee (quarterly income fee over a 1.25% hurdle with full catch-up, annual cumulative capital gains fee) requires the reader to state that the loss carryforward applies only to the capital gains fee. The three absence fields (key person, GP commitment, prime broker) each sit next to near-miss content: named side-letter key persons, a disclosed $14.2 million adviser holding, and a custodian and credit facility lender.

traps.management_fee: The appended Hallowby College side letter cuts that investor's fee to 0.95% unless repurchases take its Capital Account below $40,000,000 (a decline from investment performance does not restore the higher rate); the fund-level rate is 1.25% per annum of net asset value under Section 4.1.
traps.lockup_period: The side letter waives the Early Repurchase Deduction for Hallowby only; the Fund has no hard lock but a one-year soft lock with a 2.0% deduction under Section 6.4.
traps.redemption_notice_days: After a Key Person Notice the side letter lets Hallowby tender on 30 days' notice for one Repurchase Date, and Section 6.1 has a 20 Business Day Repurchase Offer Notice running from the Fund; the investor notice period is 60 days under Section 6.2.
traps.key_man_provision: The side letter names Dalia Ferrante and Nicholas Oyelaran and grants Hallowby a notification right, but Section 3.2 states the Partnership Agreement has no key person provision, so the fund-level answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.legal_counsel: The side letter notice clause names Marchbank Toller LLP as counsel to the investor and Section 8.4 names Rushmere Quaye as Cayman counsel to the Parallel Fund only; counsel to the Fund is Pellow Ainsworth LLP.
traps.gp_commitment: Section 3.3 discloses about $14.2 million of Interests held by the Adviser and its personnel but states that no commitment has been made or is required, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.prime_broker: Section 8.5 states the Fund does not engage a prime broker; Garrowby Trust Company, N.A. (custodian) and Sallowfield Bank, N.A. (credit facility lender) are not prime brokers.
